newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, hovers above support after API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, hovers above support after API.

text.p: May Brent crude futures were quoted around the London close at midday Wednesday in Asia, buoyed by the latest API oil data.
May was quoted at $19.52/$19.62 per barrel after London ended down five cents at $19.54.
Brokers said there was strong support for the London market below $19.50, which would support Brent on SIMEX.
In addition, NYMEX crude was firm in the wake of API data, which showed a bigger-than-expected rise in refinery utilisation rates.
API said the rates rose to 92.7 percent from 90.4 a week earlier, supported by a surprise crude draw of 2.2 million barrels when a build had been expected.
May NYMEX crude, trading on ACCESS, was last traded at $21.04 per barrel, up five cents from New York and holding above support at $21.00.
